lesson.title: Procedure 110 – CRIMES IN PROGRESS AND MAJOR INCIDENTS
lesson.topic: CRIMES IN PROGRESS AND MAJOR INCIDENTS
objectives: Apply required dispatch time standards for Critical/Serious and Non-critical Crimes in Progress.
Use the required holding steps (a–g) to secure units, notify supervisors, and document actions.
Understand queue/event monitor behavior when time standards are missed and when to pull adjacent precinct units.
